title: Compact defaults matrix and fallback planner for cost-aware inference
author: Aisha Verma
description: Motivation: many customers hit higher-than-expected unit costs because sensible batching, cache, and quantization defaults are either too aggressive for small tail workloads or too conservative for high-throughput tenants. This PR introduces a compact defaults matrix generator plus a fallback planner that simplifies autopilot behavior for Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments and gives ops explicit, auditable rules for graceful degradation. Key changes: 1) defaults matrix builder that consumes workload sketches (p95 latency, seq length distribution, qps buckets) and emits a small set of presets (batch_size, prefill_budget, kv_cache_ttl, quant_profile) tuned by cost-latency tradeoffs; 2) fallback planner that maps SLOs and capacity tiers to ordered fallback strategies (scale, model-variant, quant-fallback, regional-failover) and exposes a deterministic evaluation function for rollouts; 3) telemetry and unit-econ calibration hooks (metrics + synthetic-sample harness) so we can measure expected unit cost delta before enabling a profile; 4) CLI and Console surface to preview and apply suggested defaults; 5) docs and canary rollout plan. Checklist: implements unit tests and integration smoke tests; adds example workload sketches; includes rollout playbook and rollback steps; updates docs. Rollout plan: staged canary on 10% of new Hosted signups -> 25% -> 100% across regions with observability gating on unit_econ_regression and latency_violation alerts. Related work: ENG-4321 (cost defaults), ENG-4390 (fallback routing policies), SUP-1209 (customer support case patterns). Notable limitations: profiler relies on representative replay traces; aggressive quant profiles are gated by quality regression monitors. Requested reviewers: runtime and SRE for safety; CLI/docs for UX. Links: Linear ENG-4321 (internal), Support ticket SUP-1209 (internal).

review_comments: Evan Summers (2025-11-07): Can you add an explicit safety budget for prefill that caps memory usage per-GPU? Otherwise high prefill on bursty tenants may OOM. Response: added prefill_budget cap and unit test in commit 7.
Priya Nandakumar (2025-11-09): The planner looks good but we need an opt-out for Dedicated customers with strict isolation. Response: added a policy flag and Console toggle; documented in docs file.
Jorge Alvarez (2025-11-11): CI flaked on the telemetry integration — looks like a timing dependency. Response: added retry/backoff in test harness and moved to deterministic mock clock.
release_notes: Introduce a compact defaults matrix generator that produces cost/latency presets and a deterministic fallback planner to sequence model/quant/region fallbacks. New telemetry hooks and CLI preview allow safe canarying. Customers may notice lower unit costs for workloads that match presets; aggressive quantization remains gated by quality monitors.
